inputs.text: A judge blocked a pro-life law, and the story has shifted from protecting unborn lives to institutions defending abortion in the name of religious freedom. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice supplied the argument, while the system’s framing makes that reversal seem principled and any limits seem oppressive. It doesn’t look like an accidental shift in emphasis; it looks like a coordinated effort to steer people toward seeing that as the real issue.
